corrections.claim: Before you start, which address to open
corrections.before: Use the address that people will open in their browsers, so emailed links return to the right instance.
corrections.after: The operator gives you the instance address and the setup token. Open OpenLaw at exactly the instance address (scheme, host name, port). From any other address OpenLaw refuses to save and shows "This request did not come from this OpenLaw instance's own origin." Links to Serve the intended origin.

corrections.claim: Create the first Administrator, step 1, where the setup token comes from
corrections.before: The operator reads it from the app log at first start, or sets it with SETUP_TOKEN before the start.
corrections.after: SETUP_TOKEN when set; otherwise the app prints a new token each time it starts while no user exists, read under Compose with docker compose logs app. A restart replaces a printed token, so ask for the current one.

limitations: Source inspection only. The V-C35 browser walkthrough must run again against 067c1646; the prior walkthrough at 432dba3a had no setup token, origin check, Start blank, or email logo.

The documentation lab sets BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<port> and writes SETUP_TOKEN into the lab .env and app overlay (scripts/documentation/lab.mjs). The walkthrough must open 127.0.0.1, not localhost, or every save returns the origin refusal, and it must read the token from the lab .env.
The registry does not ask for the setup-token or origin negative checks, but the guide now states both messages; the walkthrough can check a wrong token and a wrong-origin save cheaply.

Start blank refusals for a user-added row and an in-use seed row need a row created before Review. The first is reachable by adding a type in Settings from a Review list link. The onboarding-complete refusal needs two Administrator sessions and is realistic only as a race.

The email-header logo was checked in source only: the test email and set-password invitation pass the org settings row, and the layout attaches the 48x48 PNG copy as cid:org-logo@openlaw. A walkthrough can confirm it in Mailpit after uploading a logo.

The structural check printed 'ok, warnings: 2' (stale review only) on the final content. One intermediate run failed on another group's in-progress entity-records anchor in the shared worktree; it passed once that group's edit landed.

After the first record, prettier reformatted first-run.md at commit a9f1ffdb, so the committed hash was 175f145d…, not 3811a345…. The walkthrough then failed on the empty-token sentence. The corrected content is ef145063…. The Setup token field is in apps/web/src/routes/setup.tsx, the /auth/setup route, not in the welcome route.

productBugs.symptom: The Start blank dialog says it keeps 'the Other types' and does not mention the Default type, which Start blank also keeps in Matter types and Contract types.

productBugs.symptom: The refusal for a user-added row says 'Remove them first', but Settings has no delete control for types or statuses, and archived user rows still block. The only way forward in the interface is to keep the seeds.

sharedFileRequests: docs/user-guides/install.md (operator-install group): the operator steps do not mention the setup token. Add that the app prints it in the log (docker compose logs app) on each start while no user exists, that a restart replaces it, and that SETUP_TOKEN pins it. Also name TRUSTED_PROXIES for installs behind a reverse proxy (TECH-031, TECH-032, docs/DEPLOYMENT.md).

docs/user-guides/deployment-configuration.md (operator-install group): no variable table or section names SETUP_TOKEN or TRUSTED_PROXIES; 'Serve the intended origin' could say that saves from any other origin get the 403 own-origin refusal (TECH-033).

CONTEXT.md, Setup checklist entry: it says Email 'has no pane and is plain text'. Since 27e05ca3 the Email row links to Settings → Advanced → Outbound email. The Start blank entry also omits the Default type among kept rows.
